correctness.rationale: The focal Lin--Xu--Yu arXiv:2609.36723v1 has a limiting kernel K_tau(x)=exp(-s0 x) P(x)+O(exp(-b x)), 0<s0<b, with nonzero real finite trigonometric P of nonzero distinct frequencies. Its Lemma 4.3 proves liminf P<0. Applied to -P it also proves limsup P>0, so alternating signs occur at arbitrarily large, finitely chosen x_0<...<x_N. Uniform convergence K_h(x,0)->K_tau(x) for all real x is Theorem 3.5 (NOT Theorem 4.6 as the source RESULT.md erroneously says). Lemma 5.2 yields convergence of finite truncation kernel values at each of the finitely many probes. A common sufficiently small h and large finite truncation M preserve signs and yield N distinct real zeros by continuity. The conformal multiplier J_alpha(x)J_alpha(0)>0 and the finite conjugation-invariant A excluding the real line preserve them under psi(x)=tanh(x/2). The polynomial product(z-a) for a in A belongs to I_A and is nonzero at each real kernel zero; hence these are extraneous. This proves each finite N, not one fixed finite A with infinitely many zeros. Repaired the erroneous theorem cross-reference in complete RESULT.md without changing the quantified mathematical statement.
